selection_policy.crop_policy: Crop only along the intentional contact-sheet panel grid; every crop preserves the complete object.
selection_policy.result: Three balanced eight-panel reference boards yield 24 exact one-object crops: model, practice, and unseen-transfer variants for all eight labels.

derived_masters.purpose: purpose-made eight-panel table-object reference board variant 1
derived_masters.teaching_claim: The eight-panel master contains exactly one complete text-free depiction per panel in frozen order: cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, drinking glass, napkin.
